text:
Anya: Quick sync — scheduling an inference benchmark readout next week. Thinking 30m. Proposed agenda:
```
1) benchmark results (p50/p95 latency, throughput, cost/unit)
2) dashboard walk-through (new latency vs cost view)
3) perf regressions / open investigations
4) rollout plan + owners (canary, fallback)
5) Q&A / action items
```
Can everyone indicate availability? Prefer Tue/Wed 10-11am PT. Also would like infra + product reps in the room — @Sam @Miguel can you join?

Sam: Tue works for me. Can we make it 45? there's a couple regressions I want to step through quickly.

Miguel: Wed 10 is better for me. I'll bring the cost breakdown and the model/quant table. @Leah can you present the dashboard?

Leah: I can present dashboard, Wed OK but prefer 30m. I can trim the walkthrough to 10m and highlight new panels. :+1:

Pranav: I'm OOO Tue but Wed works. I'll prepare a short note on KV cache effects and batching knobs.

dev-bot: Reminder: include Zoom link + attach artifacts (benchmark CSV, perf diffs, dashboard link) when you send the calendar invite.

Anya: OK looks like Wed 10am PT wins. I'll create invite for 30min with an option to extend to 45 if needed. Draft invite snippet:
```
Topic: Inference perf readout (eng-ml)
Agenda: see thread
Artifacts: benchmark CSV, perf diffs, dashboard link
Owners: Anya (host), Miguel (cost), Leah (dashboard), Sam (regressions)
Duration: 30m (extendable)
```
I can host. Any objections to keeping it 30m? If we hit heavy discussion we can extend.

Sam: no objections. I'll drop a 2-slide summary of the regressions and the temp fixes we tried. Also can we add 'smoke test checklist' to action items?

Miguel: +1 to smoke checklist. I'll include a small table in the artifacts: model | quant | hw | p50 | p95 | cost/token so folks can scan quickly.

Leah: I'll prepare the dashboard link and a short export of the latency vs cost chart. I'll also add a short script snippet for reproducing the batch-size experiment.

Pranav: I'll add the KV cache note as a single-page doc.

Anya: Great — I'll send invite in ~10m and attach the placeholders. Tagging @eng-ml for visibility. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
